claims.subject: alias table method
claims.evidence_quote: We use the alias table method [9] to draw a sample according to the weights of the edges, which takes onlyO(1) time when repeatedly drawing samples from the same discrete distribution.

claims.subject: alias table method
claims.evidence_quote: Sampling an edge from the alias table takes constant time, O(1), and optimization with negative sampling takesO(d(K+ 1)) time, whereK is the number of negative samples.
